subject: Clarify invoicing & VAT treatment for US reseller selling to EU end customers
messages:
From: Sofia Moreno <accounts@olivepay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:03:00 +0000
Subject: Question on VAT treatment for EU shipping (OlivePay US as reseller)

Hi Dylan,

Quick one — we are onboarding Redwood for a reseller flow. OlivePay Inc. (US) will be reselling Redwood credits/services to our EU customers. Our operational flow is: OlivePay US invoices the end customer in EUR, the end customer is located in the EU, and OlivePay bills us (Redwood) via a master reseller agreement.

Two questions we need clarified so we can close this internally:
1) From Redwood's perspective, if the end customer is an EU business, do we need to apply VAT on invoices to OlivePay US, or is reverse-charge applicable (i.e., zero-rate on Redwood invoice with buyer-side VAT reporting)?
2) If reverse-charge is possible, what proof do you need from us (VAT ID for EU buyer, VIES validation, PO/contract evidence) — and can Redwood issue a proforma invoice now while we collect the buyer proof?

I attached a draft proforma so you can see the line items we expect.

Thanks,
Sofia Moreno
Accounts Payable — OlivePay
[Attachment: proforma_invoice_OLIVEPAY_05052026.pdf (pdf, 95KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Moreno <accounts@olivepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on VAT treatment for EU shipping (OlivePay US as reseller)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear summary and the proforma. I copied Karthik (finance) and Marissa (tax ops) so we can confirm the appropriate routing and documentation.

To answer at a high level: reverse-charge can be applicable when (a) the supply is deemed to be to an EU VAT-registered business and (b) we have the buyer's valid VAT ID and supporting proof of B2B status. However, the exact approach depends on which legal entity is the contracting party for the supply (OlivePay US vs OlivePay Europe B.V.).

Please can you confirm the following so we can give a definitive answer and produce an invoice variant that will not block your downstream VAT flows: 
- Which legal entity should Redwood invoice for the reseller seat/credits (OlivePay Inc. — US entity, or OlivePay Europe B.V. — EU entity)?
- For the EU-supplied end customers, can you provide examples (2–3) of end-customer POs or signed reseller addenda that show B2B billing?
- A copy of the EU entity's VAT certificate (if you want us to route invoices to OlivePay Europe) or the end-customer VAT IDs we can validate.

As a temporary measure, we can issue a proforma for cash-flow/approval purposes with a note that final VAT treatment will be applied on the taxable invoice after we validate VAT IDs / buyer proof. If you want us to invoice OlivePay Europe directly, please attach the EU VAT certificate for OlivePay Europe B.V. so we can verify via VIES.

I attached our proforma template so you can see the fields we'll need filled for tax reporting.

Next steps: once we have the VAT certificate or two sample POs, Karthik/Marissa will run a quick validation and confirm which invoice path is safe to use.

Best,
Dylan
Director, Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_proforma_template.pdf (pdf, 60KB)]

Per your note, OlivePay Europe B.V. is the EU subsidiary we would prefer you invoice. Attached is the EU VAT certificate for OlivePay Europe B.V.

VAT number: NL123456789B01
Legal name: OlivePay Europe B.V.
Registered address: Keizersgracht 123, 1015CJ Amsterdam, Netherlands

We can also provide two sample end-customer POs for B2B accounts (attached as part of our billing packet) — those POs include the end-customer VAT IDs. Please proceed with a VIES check and confirm whether Redwood can issue a tax-exempt invoice (reverse-charge) to OlivePay Europe or if you still prefer to invoice OlivePay US and append an RC annex.

Thanks — attaching certificate and the sample PO stub.

Sofia Moreno
Head of Billing Operations — OlivePay
[Attachment: vat_certificate_olivepay_eu_sub.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Moreno <billing-eu@olivepay.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on VAT treatment for EU shipping (OlivePay US as reseller)

Dylan / Marissa — quick technical summary for the thread (copying Sofia so she's aware of the options):

1) If Redwood invoices OlivePay Europe B.V. (EU legal entity) and that entity is VAT-registered and the supply is to a business, the invoice can be zero-rated with a reverse-charge reference (we omit VAT) — provided we validate the VAT ID via VIES and retain the EU VAT certificate / PO evidence in our records.

2) If Redwood invoices OlivePay Inc. (US entity) but the underlying supply is to EU businesses, we can still document reverse-charge on the invoice only if OlivePay Inc. confirms it's acting as an agent/collector for the EU legal entity and provides the end-customer VAT IDs and evidence. That path is higher friction and requires stronger proof.

3) Practical ask: please provide either (A) confirmation to bill OlivePay Europe B.V. plus the VAT certificate (fastest), or (B) if you must be billed to OlivePay Inc., please provide 2–3 paired end-customer POs that include VAT IDs so we can tie each supply to a B2B transaction.

I ran a preliminary VIES lookup for NL123456789B01 — see the attached result (this is a cached lookup; final runtime check will occur when we generate the invoice).

If you want us to proceed now we can:
- Option 1: Issue a taxable invoice to OlivePay Europe B.V. with reverse-charge wording (no VAT) — requires stored VAT certificate and one confirmation email per calendar quarter.
- Option 2: Issue invoice to OlivePay Inc. and include an annex; hold VAT accounting until you provide per-customer proof (delays payment reconciliation).

Recommend Option 1 for lower operational friction.

Karthik
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vies_lookup_results.txt (txt, 3KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Moreno <billing-eu@olivepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on VAT treatment for EU shipping (OlivePay US as reseller)

Thanks, Sofia — that helps. Summary and next steps below so we have a clear checklist: 

1) Your ask: Redwood to support reverse-charge / zero-rated invoices for reseller flows where the EU legal entity (OlivePay Europe B.V.) is the buyer.

2) Redwood recommendation (per Karthik): Invoice OlivePay Europe B.V. directly and apply reverse-charge (Option 1). This avoids per-customer PO tying and speeds processing.

3) We need from you (please upload to the portal or attach to a reply):
   - The VAT certificate (we received NL123456789B01 — thanks).
   - Confirmation that Redwood should route invoices to billing-eu@olivepay.com and that OlivePay Europe B.V. is the legal buyer for Redwood services.
   - Two sample end-customer PO numbers (for our audit copy) — not the full contract text, just PO number + end-customer VAT ID will suffice.

4) I'll prepare a sample zero-rated invoice and send it over for your approval before we start month-end cycle billing.

If you confirm "bill OlivePay Europe B.V." and upload the two sample POs, we'll run one final VIES check and then issue a test invoice (no VAT) to confirm your AP system accepts it.

Best,
Dylan
Director, Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
